scope: Roadmap step 2 (main body): the compiled-tensor capacity basis moves from post-codegen Inductor allocation reads to a graph-derived account with a named slack fraction; the adapter stops disabling Inductor features
user_decision: 2026-09-15: 'adapter不应该禁止inductor的功能…只使用torch export中的图上信息，并做略微的合理高估' — '就图帐+margin吧'. Capacity for safe scheduling comes only from export-graph information plus a modest overestimate margin, replacing codegen allocation reads

account.formula: per device: scratch = ceil((1 + COMPILER_SLACK_FRACTION) * (sum of layout-span bytes of every non-placeholder tensor value in the normalized fx graph + sum of input spans of sum/mean reduction ops))
account.reduction_input_charge: covers split-reduction partial buffers: nsplit never exceeds the reduced element count, so partials never exceed input bytes
account.gemm: deterministic first-valid plain mm/bmm Triton template override kept (up to 4 configs); plain templates carry no workspace and the override excludes extern (cublas) calls whose workspace the graph cannot name
account.slack_covers: concat packing, reduction semaphores, allocator rounding
account.emission: KernelAllocation entries (unique names, source devices) summed by aer.rs call_memory unchanged; identity string bumped to inductor-tensor-readonly@7 with the slack fraction encoded so driver and worker re-derivation agree
account.operator_subset: normalized-graph whitelist: pointwise math, metadata views, cat/stack, sum/mean, plain GEMM family, prims.convert_element_type; anything else may lower to library workspace the graph account cannot see, so the backend declines and the original execution path is kept — a narrowing of the capacity promise, not a disabled Inductor feature

removed._post_fusion_custom_pass: GraphLowering capture used to enumerate codegen buffers
removed.buffer_enumeration: lowered.buffers / scheduler inspection and allocation reads
removed.output_layout_guard: compile-time output-stride check via captured GraphLowering (runtime TensorSignature.check per call remains)

kept_guards: artifact-level execution-convention guards: mutated_inputs, constants, torchbind_constants, inputs_to_check (alignment copies)
offset-one fake inputs (codegen must accept unaligned borrows)
triton.cudagraphs=False (cudagraph pools are allocator state the account cannot name)

consequences.bound_not_estimate: fused-away intermediates are still charged (deliberate over-count); measured peak stays strictly under the bound
consequences.tests: pins moved from 'codegen read equals measured peak' to the account formula and peak <= bound; batching test payload limit raised 100000 -> 200000 because the packed operands are charged for pack + view + f32 upcast
consequences.side_effect: the two pre-existing test_inplace_region bitwise CUDA failures disappeared once default Inductor features (inplace buffers, buffer reuse, memory planning) were restored — the old pins themselves had changed codegen numerics on this machine
